points.text: Each tablet supplies 200 mg elemental magnesium provided as magnesium citrate.
Each tablet supplies 2 mg vitamin B6 provided as pyridoxine hydrochloride.
A daily intake of two tablets supplies 400 mg elemental magnesium and 4 mg vitamin B6.
Take 1 tablet twice daily after meals.
Both the 60-tablet and 120-tablet pack sizes contain the same tablet formulation.
At two tablets daily, the 60-tablet pack lasts 30 days and the 120-tablet pack lasts 60 days.
Prices include applicable tax and delivery with zero delivery charge.
